notes: Four library types: rz_5m (unfragmented, 5'-end identification -> end_mapping), rz_frg_5m (heat-fragmented rRNA-depleted, quantification -> total_rnaseq, somewhat uncertain since same template-switch protocol), rz_5m_trna (tRNA gel size selection -> other), tot_30m (no depletion, unfragmented, rRNA cleavage/maturation -> end_mapping). Cells washed and resuspended in M9 lacking glucose (glycerol + casamino acids) 30 min before arabinose; treated as part of the protocol, treatment none. Toxins are native MG1655 TA toxins -> native_overexpression; empty vector + arabinose is the control.

base_medium.q: M9 (10x stock made with 64 g/L Na2HPO4-7H2O, 15 g/L KH2PO4, 2.5 g/L NaCl, 5.0 g/L NH4Cl) medium supplemented with 0.1% casamino acids, 0.4% glycerol

medium_class.q: M9 (10x stock made with 64 g/L Na2HPO4-7H2O, 15 g/L KH2PO4, 2.5 g/L NaCl, 5.0 g/L NH4Cl) medium supplemented with 0.1% casamino acids, 0.4% glycerol

carbon_source.q: resuspended in M9 media lacking glucose

culture_mode.q: grown at 37°C on a Synergy H1 plate reader (BioTek) in 24-well plates

oxygen.q: in 24-well plates using double orbital rotation at 307 CPM

growth_temperature.q: grown at 37°C on a Synergy H1 plate reader (BioTek) in 24-well plates

treatment.q: The libraries were generated from E. coli cells expressing 9 different toxins or an empty vector from an arabinose inducible promoter.

inducer_added.q: toxin was induced by adding arabinose to 0.2%

transcription_arrested.q: The libraries were generated from E. coli cells expressing 9 different toxins or an empty vector from an arabinose inducible promoter.

mixed_organism.q: The libraries were generated from E. coli cells expressing 9 different toxins or an empty vector from an arabinose inducible promoter.

genotype_class.q: 9 endoribonuclease toxins from toxin-antitoxin systems in E. coli MG1655

global_regulator_perturbed.q: 9 endoribonuclease toxins from toxin-antitoxin systems in E. coli MG1655

is_control.q: The libraries were generated from E. coli cells expressing 9 different toxins or an empty vector from an arabinose inducible promoter.

rrna_removal.q: rRNA was removed by hybridization to custom biotinylated oligos

assay_class.q: These libraries were intended to identify RNA 5’-ends generated by endoribonuclease toxin cleavage.
